title: Autism Diagnoses Reached 32.2 Per Thousand—But Location Changes The Rate
hook: Autism diagnoses hit 32.2 per thousand, but geography changes the number.
closing: Screening access shapes reported autism rates, so raw increases need context.
question: Has screening changed near you?

segments.say: Autism diagnoses reached 32.2 per thousand children. Broader identification now captures far more children.
Boys measured 49.2 per thousand. Diagnosis patterns remain sharply uneven by sex.
One site measured 52.6 per thousand. Where children get screened can reshape reported autism rates.
